cases.question: What is the nationality of the most successful female ski racer ever?
cases.question_zh: 最成功的女性滑雪运动员的国籍是什么？
cases.diagnosis_zh: 三种条件都回答 Croatian，但金标证据明确把历史上最成功的女性滑雪运动员指向美国选手 Lindsey Vonn。这是实质性的实体判断错误。

evidence.title: Vreni Schneider
facts: Verena "Vreni" Schneider (born 26 November 1964) is a retired ski racer from Switzerland.

She is the most successful alpine ski racer of her country, the third most successful female ski racer ever (after Lindsey Vonn and Annemarie Moser-Pröll) and was voted "Swiss Sportswoman of the Century".
facts_zh: Verena "Vreni" Schneider（1964年11月26日出生）是一位来自瑞士的退役滑雪运动员。
她是本国最成功的高山滑雪运动员，也是历史上第三成功的女性滑雪运动员（在Lindsey Vonn和Annemarie Moser-Pröll之后），并被评为"20世纪瑞士最杰出女性运动员"。

evidence.title: Lindsey Vonn
facts: Lindsey Caroline Vonn ( ) (née Kildow ; born October 18, 1984) is an American World Cup alpine ski racer on the US Ski Team.
facts_zh: Lindsey Caroline Vonn（出生日期：1984年10月18日）是美国世界滑雪杯高山滑雪运动员，效力于美国滑雪队。

cases.question: What British singer-songwriter hosted the 16th Annual Young Hollywood Awards?
cases.question_zh: 哪位英国歌手兼词曲作者主持了第16届年度青年好莱坞颁奖典礼？
cases.diagnosis_zh: Paragraph 与 Sentence 都回答 Kelly Osbourne，语义上指向正确人物；strict EM 因标准答案使用全名 Kelly Lee Osbourne 而判错。Baseline 没有给出答案。

evidence.title: 2014 Young Hollywood Awards
facts: The 16th Annual Young Hollywood Awards were held on Monday, July 28, 2014 in Los Angeles, California, previously recorded the day before.
Kelly Osbourne hosted the show, with Justin Bieber being honored for his charity work and contributions to the Make-A-Wish Foundation, and Vanessa Hudgens was honored with the Trendsetter Award.
facts_zh: 第16届年度青年好莱坞颁奖典礼于2014年7月28日星期一在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶举行，此前一天已录制。
Kelly Osbourne主持了该活动，Justin Bieber因慈善工作和对Make-A-Wish基金会的贡献获得表彰，Vanessa Hudgens则获得趋势设定奖。

evidence.title: Kelly Osbourne
facts: Kelly Lee Osbourne (born 27 October 1984) is a British singer-songwriter, actress, television presenter and fashion designer.
facts_zh: Kelly Lee Osbourne（出生于1984年10月27日）是一位英国歌手、词曲作者、演员、电视主持人和时尚设计师。

cases.question: which sultan of the Ottoman Empire was  Gevherhan Sultan her granddaughter
cases.question_zh: Gevherhan Sultan 是哪位奥斯曼帝国苏丹的孙女？
cases.diagnosis_zh: Suleiman the Magnificent 与标准答案 Suleiman I 是同一人，三种条件都是别名导致的 strict EM 失败。

evidence.title: Gevherhan Sultan (daughter of Selim II)
evidence.title_zh: Gevherhan Sultan（塞利姆二世的女儿）
facts: She was the granddaughter of Suleiman the Magnificent (reign 1520–66) and Hürrem Sultan, sister of Sultan Murad III (reign 1574–95) and aunt of Sultan Mehmed III (reign 1595–1603).
facts_zh: 她是苏莱曼大帝（1520–1566年在位）和赫尔雷姆·苏丹的孙女，是苏丹穆拉德三世（1574–1595年在位）的妹妹，也是苏丹梅赫梅特三世（1595–1603年在位）的姨妈。

evidence.title: Suleiman the Magnificent
facts: Suleiman I (Ottoman Turkish: سلطان سليمان اول‎ "Sultan Süleyman-ı Evvel"; Turkish: "I. Süleyman, Kanunî Sultan Süleyman "or" Muhteşem Süleyman" ; 6 November 1494 – 6 September 1566), commonly known as Suleiman the Magnificent in the West and Kanunî Sultan Süleyman (Ottoman Turkish: قانونى سلطان سليمان‎) (English: "The Lawgiver Suleiman") in his realm, was the tenth and longest-reigning sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1520 to his death in 1566.
facts_zh: 苏莱曼一世（奥斯曼土耳其语：سلطان سليمان اول，土耳其语：I. Süleyman，或Kanunî Sultan Süleyman，或Muhteşem Süleyman；1494年11月6日－1566年9月6日），通常在西方被称为苏莱曼大帝，其国内则称其为‘法典苏丹苏莱曼’（Kanunî Sultan Süleyman），是奥斯曼帝国的第十位苏丹，从1520年统治至1566年去世，是统治时间最长的苏丹之一。

cases.question: What was the rank of the leader of the army defeated by West Saxon forces?
cases.question_zh: 被西撒克逊军队击败的那支军队，其领袖是什么身份？
cases.diagnosis_zh: 证据同时称 Ubba 为 Viking chieftain 和 Great Army 的 commander；模型回答 chieftain 有直接证据支持，而标准答案 commanders of the Great Army 并不是清晰的“军衔”。题目与标注边界存在歧义。

evidence.title: Odda, Ealdorman of Devon
facts: He is known for his victory at the Battle of Cynwit in 878, where his West Saxon forces defeated a Viking army led by Ubba, brother of the Viking chiefs Ivar the Boneless and Halfdan Ragnarsson.
facts_zh: 他因在878年的辛维特战役中取得胜利而闻名，当时他的西撒克逊部队击败了由乌巴领导的维京军队，乌巴是维京首领伊瓦尔·骨瘦如柴和哈夫丹·拉格纳松的兄弟。

evidence.title: Ubba
facts: Ubba, also known as Hubba, Ubbe, and Ubbi, was a mid-ninth-century Viking chieftain and one of the commanders of the Great Army, a coalition of Norse warriors that in AD 865 invaded the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms of Northumbria, Mercia, East Anglia and Wessex.
facts_zh: 乌巴，也被称为Hubba、Ubbe和Ubbi，是九世纪中叶的一位维京首领，是Great Army的指挥官之一，该联盟由诺尔斯战士组成，于公元865年入侵了盎格鲁-撒克逊王国的诺森布里亚、麦西亚、东盎格利亚和韦塞克斯。

cases.question: Who aided the Colorado forces in the Uruguayan war?
cases.question_zh: 谁在乌拉圭战争中支援了科罗拉多部队？
cases.diagnosis_zh: 金标问题要的是援助 Flores 的 Argentina；模型把同场作战的 Empire of Brazil 也并入答案，产生了多余实体。

evidence.title: Siege of Salto
facts: The Siege of Salto occurred during the Uruguayan War, from 22 until 28 November 1864, when Brazilian forces (under Marquis of Tamandaré) and Colorado forces (under Venancio Flores) attempted to capture the city of Salto in Uruguay from Uruguayan Army defenders.
facts_zh: 萨尔托围城战发生在1864年11月22日至28日的乌拉圭战争期间，巴西部队（由塔曼达雷侯爵指挥）和科罗拉多部队（由文纳西奥·弗洛雷斯指挥）试图从乌拉圭军队守军手中夺取乌拉圭萨尔托市。

evidence.title: Uruguayan War
facts: Flores was aided by Argentina, whose president Bartolomé Mitre provided him with supplies, Argentine volunteers and river transport for troops.
facts_zh: 弗洛雷斯得到了阿根廷的支援，阿根廷总统巴托洛梅·米特雷为其提供了物资、阿根廷志愿兵以及军队的河流运输。

cases.question: What was need in order to diverge from the chinese ritual uniting spouses by pre-arrangement between families?
cases.question_zh: 为了摆脱中国通过家族间预先安排来联合配偶的仪式，需要什么？
cases.diagnosis_zh: 标准答案问的是新婚姻法落地所需的持续宣传支持。模型把法律本身、法律改革和宣传混为答案，没有抽取问题真正指向的条件。

evidence.title: New Marriage Law
facts: It was a radical change from existing patriarchal Chinese marriage traditions, and needed constant support from propaganda campaigns.
facts_zh: 它是对现有父权制中国婚姻传统的根本性改变，需要持续的宣传运动支持。
